definitions.explanation: A vessel or appliance used to boil water. Can refer to a stovetop kettle, an electric kettle, or a hot water heater.

examples.japanese: {湯沸|ゆわ}かしでお{湯|ゆ}を{沸|わ}かす。
examples.english: To boil water with a kettle.

examples.japanese: {事務所|じむしょ}に{電気|でんき}{湯沸|ゆわ}かし{器|き}が{設置|せっち}されている。
examples.english: An electric water heater is installed in the office.

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}い{湯沸|ゆわ}かし{器|き}は{不完全|ふかんぜん}{燃焼|ねんしょう}を{起|お}こす{恐|おそ}れがあるので、{定期的|ていきてき}に{点検|てんけん}してください。
examples.english: Old water heaters may cause incomplete combustion, so please have them inspected regularly.

notes:
USAGE:
Can refer to both a simple kettle ({湯沸|ゆわ}かし or やかん) and a gas or electric water heating unit ({湯沸|ゆわ}かし{器|き}). In offices and kitchens, {湯沸|ゆわ}かし{室|しつ} refers to the room with hot water facilities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電気|でんき}{湯沸|ゆわ}かし{器|き} (electric water heater)
- {瞬間|しゅんかん}{湯沸|ゆわ}かし{器|き} (instant water heater)
- {湯沸|ゆわ}かし{室|しつ} (kitchenette; hot water room)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- やかん: kettle — the more common everyday word for a stovetop kettle
- {電気|でんき}ポット: electric pot — an electric kettle that keeps water hot
- ケトル: kettle — loanword, increasingly common
